milestone: Checked half-open Unicode scalar slicing of immutable CPU Strings

implementation.source: slice(text,start,end) returns String for scalar range [start,end); bounds independently accept int32/uint32/int64/uint64; empty/end/full ranges supported without clamping
implementation.frontend: Strict input/bound/result types and arity; known negative/high/reversed/out-of-range bounds rejected; known differences propagate scalar extents through existing immutable binding checks
implementation.IR: Separate StringSlice with typed input/start/end/result and checked runtime call; each 32-bit bound independently sign/zero extends
implementation.runtime: Locate both byte boundaries in the complete strict UTF-8 validation scan, publishing range metadata only on success; canonical empties skip result allocation but never input validation
implementation.ownership: Copy nonempty ranges into independent invocation-owned buffers; parent release and retained result lifetime qualified; descriptor output may alias input
implementation.faults: BoundsFault for bad scalar ranges, RuntimeFault for malformed owners/UTF-8, AllocationFault for result allocation failure; interrupted/failed scans and copies leave result empty and settle owners
implementation.limits: CPU synchronous only; ordinary String workers/captures and String compound elements remain gated. Shared views and earlier temporary reclamation remain optimization work.

coverage: All design slice vectors; complete interval grid over ASCII/Persian/combining/emoji/joiner/NUL/BOM/U+10FFFF text
Zero/full/end ranges and canonical empty input/output; empty results do not allocate
All 16 start/end integer width combinations; high/negative/reversed/past-end dynamic bounds and compile-time extent checks
Imported helpers, pipelines, sequential callbacks, equality/length composition and subsequent-index compile-time bounds checks
Source/start/end single evaluation and left-to-right fault ordering, short circuit and construction/result failure cleanup
Independent parent/result owners, result retained after parent/context release, and aliased descriptor output
Complete malformed descriptor and trailing UTF-8 rejection even for empty slices; failed/interrupted scan range/count sentinels remain unchanged
Cancellation during full scan and after result allocation during large copies; no partial publication or leaked owners
Strict arity/types, forged IR, borrowed task diagnostic slicing and rejected-build artifact preservation
String indexing/length/equality/concatenation/validation, core semantics/continuations and numeric array indexing worker regressions
qualification.scope: Focused CPU qualification; optimized applies to generated programs/harnesses using the existing core runtime archive. No GPU/distributed/worker String implementation claim.
qualification.build_notes: Existing runtime/frontend tests were freshly rebuilt/relinked before regression checks. No production source changes after the successful focused run.

native/lib/CheckedABI.cpp.change: Add checked String slicing call; preserve existing numeric rules
